name: 3rd Chaos Lord · Dwarfhold Vath
notes: The whole 3rd Chaos Lord line in one run: the pines and tavern chain that opens Dwarfhold, the dwarfhold quests themselves, the upper city, and the prison break that ends with Dragonlord Vath. It is a one-pass route (`once`), so a quest this character has handed in is remembered and never taken again, and the run stops itself once nothing is left; each pass works on whatever is already in hand, otherwise the next quest of the chain the server actually offers, so a restart picks up where the character is. Six of the 36 are not fights: 319, 337, 344, 346, 362 and 363 are map items, clicked by the id the map's own sparkle sends, on a loop until the quest asks for nothing. 319 clicks from the tavern's spawn cell; the rest stop combat and stand on the Blank cell first, where nothing can reach them, because a click is a packet and does not need the sparkle in sight. 353 and 356 are hunts: their turn-ins want counters paid in different cells, so the route walks between r9 and r8 and farms whichever counter is still short instead of sitting in one room forever. 323, 343, 354 and 357 are turn-ins that only want a temp item the line pays earlier, so their check sends the character back to 327, 340, 353 and 356 rather than waiting on a counter that will never arrive. A fight step hands over the moment the quest reads complete rather than finishing the mob, and every turn-in stops combat first, so a finished quest never keeps the boss angry. Loot is claimed as it falls (`pickup`): these quests pay real drops with names a route cannot list ahead of time. The last steps buy the Volcanic Fire Sword from shop 947, the line's proof item, and end quietly if that shop is not unlocked.

do.msg: 3rd Chaos Lord complete: nothing left to accept
